MARKING CRITERIA (out of 4):
4 marks: Relates cause and effect of the interdependence between operations and finance
3 marks: Provides characteristics and features of the interdependence between operations and finance
2 marks: Sketches in general terms the interdependence between operations and finance
1 marks: Recognises and names interdependence between operations and finance

Interdependence refers to the relationship between operations and finance. Relate cause and effect of operations on finance AND finance on operations.
